title: Fix Storybook Tree Label Rendering for Coda Trees
description: Refactor the coda desktop UI completely to only use elements/ui components. Replace all custom inline components in renderer.tsx with their elements/ui equivalents.
summary: Fixed the Storybook regression by changing elements tree rows to prefer explicit label props over id-based translation lookup, added a regression test for TreeItem label precedence, and verified the live Storybook OntologyTree and ValidationTree stories show visible labels, truth text, witness rows, and cardinality chips again.
